descriptionExample: AAA: Action - what to do; Audience - who should act/benefit; Acceptance - measurable success criteria. Example: 'Action: Implement profile page layout components (header, avatar, activity); Audience: frontend devs; Acceptance: responsive across 320–1920px, components documented, unit tests for avatar and header.'

object.name: Profile Page Satructure
object.description: Build the profile page structure (header, avatar, bio, activity feed). Audience: frontend devs. Acceptance: responsive layout across devices, accessible markup, basic interactions (edit profile) implemented and documented.

object.name: Apologize for shopping Error!
object.description: Diagnose and fix the shopping checkout error that prevents orders. Audience: backend engineers and QA. Acceptance: reproduce on staging, implement fix, verify with end-to-end tests and update incident notes.

object.name: Post launch reminder/ Post list
object.description: Create post-launch reminder and post list features for marketing campaigns. Audience: frontend and marketing automation engineers. Acceptance: scheduled reminders work, post list fetches paginated results and matches UI spec.

object.name: User research
object.description: Conduct user research to gather insights on onboarding flow. Audience: UX researchers and product team. Acceptance: complete 8 user interviews, synthesize findings, and provide prioritized recommendations.

object.name: Make a creating an account profile
object.description: Implement account creation and profile-onboarding screens. Audience: frontend and auth engineers. Acceptance: signup flow integrated with auth service, validations in place, and onboarding checklist working.

object.name: Change email option process
object.description: Update email change process and security checks. Audience: backend and security engineers. Acceptance: secure email-change flow, email verification enforced, and tests cover edge cases.

object.name: Benner design for FB & Twitter
object.description: Design banner assets for Facebook and Twitter campaigns. Audience: design and marketing teams. Acceptance: provide 3 banner variants per platform respecting size guidelines and export-ready files.

object.name: Brand Logo design
object.description: Design and deliver brand logo options and assets. Audience: design team and product stakeholders. Acceptance: supply vector and raster formats, color variations, and usage guidelines.

object.name: Additional Calendar
object.description: Add calendar feature to chat app template for scheduling. Audience: frontend engineers and product managers. Acceptance: calendar UI integrated, event creation/editing working, and interactions tested.

object.name: Add Dynamic Contact List
object.description: Implement dynamic contact list with search and syncing. Audience: backend and frontend engineers. Acceptance: realtime sync enabled, search performant, and contact CRUD operations covered by tests.
